channel.title: RateLog — Replit Agent changelog
channel.description: Every pricing and usage-limit change RateLog has caught for Replit Agent, dated and sourced — no other tools mixed in.

item.title: Replit Agent — New Pro plan replaces Teams
item.description: [↑ improved] Discontinued the separate Teams plan for a new $100/mo Pro plan with 1-month credit rollover and up to 15 collaborators; Core's annual price dropped to $20/mo with 5 collaborators built in.

item.title: Replit Agent — Switched to effort-based billing
item.description: [changed] Replaced flat $0.25-per-checkpoint billing with effort-based pricing, where each checkpoint's cost scales with the actual compute the Agent used.
